verdicts.why: Marvel Database's appearance list for Deadpool & Wolverine says Logan 'Joins and leaves the Resistance', and his page (James Howlett, Earth-TRN1400) lists Resistance and X-Men as former affiliations. He then stays on Wade's world with no group. (The Resistance team page calls him an ally, but the two character-level sources agree he joined.)
The MCU wiki lists S.H.I.E.L.D. and Project Goliath as former and UC Berkeley as his current affiliation. In the film he is a Berkeley professor, so nothing puts him back in S.H.I.E.L.D.

The MCU wiki lists S.H.I.E.L.D. and O.X.E. as former and New Avengers as current. The team is rebranded the New Avengers at the end of Thunderbolts* and never turns back, so the trailing Thunderbolts stage is wrong.
The Att-Lass and Bron-Char pages both give Starforce as their only affiliation, with no 'formerly'. Nothing in Captain Marvel moves them out of Starforce.

In Quantumania, Cassie persuades M.O.D.O.K. that it is never too late. He betrays Kang and dies fighting him (section 'Sacrifice'). The wiki lists Kang's forces as a former affiliation. Turning on the group counts as a move.

The MCU wiki says that once he recovered, Rumlow 'abandoned Hydra, instead becoming an independent terrorist' named Crossbones. In Civil War he says, 'I didn't do this for Hydra.' HYDRA is listed as former.
The MCU wiki says that after Sharon Carter freed him, 'Batroc had gone on to join LAF' and led his own LAF team that hijacked Vassant's plane (FATWS episode 1). LAF is his current affiliation.

Wikipedia's episode summaries: Hood's gang breaks Zeke out and gives him his implants, Parker fires the gang and takes control of Zeke's body (episode 5), and Riri frees Zeke from that control (episode 6). The MCU wiki calls Hood a 'Former Ally and Former Enthraller'. That is a real departure inside Ironheart.

The MCU wiki says Blonsky founded the Abomaste self-help group during his parole and leads its meeting in 'The Retreat' (episode 7). His return to prison is not one of the owner's moves, so no departure is added.

The MCU wiki lists O.X.E. as former and New Avengers as Walker's current group. The team is presented as the New Avengers at the end of Thunderbolts* and is still that in the post-credits scene, so the trailing Thunderbolts stage is wrong.
The MCU wiki lists the U.S. Navy and SEALs as former and the Golden Tribe and Tribal Council as current. He dies as Wakanda's king in Black Panther and never goes back to the U.S. military.
The MCU wiki gives Masters of the Mystic Arts (formerly), then Zealots. He was a Kamar-Taj master before he led the Zealots, so the first Zealots stage is wrong.
The MCU wiki gives Starforce as Minn-Erva's only affiliation, with no 'formerly'. She dies as a Starforce member when Maria Rambeau shoots her down, so the trailing Kree Empire stage is wrong.

Korath serves in Starforce through Captain Marvel. The wiki lists Starforce as 'formerly' only because of his later life, and no move back to the Kree Empire happens in Captain Marvel. Removing the trailing Kree stage leaves Starforce, then Independent in Guardians of the Galaxy.

The MCU wiki lists Asgard as current and Revengers and the Sakaaran Rebellion as former. In The Dark World he is held in Asgard, fights for it, and rules it disguised as Odin. After Ragnarok he is with the Asgardian refugees. The Thor, Valkyrie and A:loki files already use Revengers, then Asgard, in Ragnarok.

Marvel Database files her as Wanda Wilson (Earth-TRN872): reality unknown, pruned to the Void, a member of the Deadpool Corps. That is the same designation used for Nicepool and Dogpool. She is not Earth-199999.
The MCU wiki says that after the Battle of Earth, 'Nebula and Rocket left the Avengers and rejoined the newly revived Guardians.' Her last Endgame stage is the Guardians, not the Avengers.

In Vol. 2 she is already in no group. She only helps Taserface's mutiny, which the wiki does not list as an affiliation, and at Yondu's funeral she declines to join the Guardians. She leaves no group there.

The MCU wiki ('Destruction of Anvil') says that with Homeland Security closing in, Russo kills the agents, sets off a bomb in Anvil Headquarters and walks away as Anvil, the company he built, is destroyed. The group ends in Punisher S1, and Anvil is listed as former.

The MCU wiki lists Jigsaw's Crew among Russo's affiliations. He builds and leads this veteran crew after escaping in Punisher S2. The record's own step says episode 7, and either way the title is The Punisher S2.

The MCU wiki says that once freed from Hydra's control, Creel 'agreed to work for Talbot as his official bodyguard once Talbot became the ATCU's Director'. ATCU is listed as a former affiliation. That is in AoS S3 (episode 56, the S3 summit).
The MCU wiki says that once Creel learned S.H.I.E.L.D. had not shot Talbot, 'he helped Coulson and Talbot escape Hale's custody'. That is turning on Hale's Hydra in AoS S5, before his death.

The MCU wiki says Malick 'resigned from his position at the World Security Council after the Chitauri Invasion' and became an advisor to President Ellis. In S3 he is a former councilman, so the S3 World Security Council stage is wrong.

The MCU wiki says Ward 'rejoined Hydra under Daniel Whitehall' and 'left the organization again after Whitehall's death along with Kara Palamas' (S2). After Kara's death he 'rejoined the remnants of Hydra, deciding to rebuild the organization and become its new leader' (S3).

The MCU wiki says that after Fennhoff's failure she 'chose to stay in the USA and became a freelance operative'. In S2, Masters tells her Leviathan views her as an embarrassment and that she is 'an assassin without a country'. Leviathan is listed as former.

Moving the Rand stage to S1 is right, but she does not 'only leave in S2'. The MCU wiki says the board 'voted the Meachums out of Rand Enterprises' (IF107), and that after Wilkins' death 'Joy was let back into the company' (section 'Reinstated', S1). She then buys out with the divestment package in S2.

In Jessica Jones S2 ('AKA Shark in the Bathtub, Monster in the Bed') Trish says on air, '...getting the hell off this shitty show. I quit.' She never returns to Trish Talk, which the wiki lists as former.
The MCU wiki gives the Carbone Crime Family as Rosalie's affiliation, current. She runs it in both Luke Cage S2 and Daredevil S3, and the record has no group.

The MCU wiki lists HYDRA and CIA as former. After the Blip the CIA program had been terminated, and Nagel went to Madripoor, 'his employment with the Power Broker'. Nothing puts him back in HYDRA, so the trailing stage is wrong. The group label is new and is the owner's to name.

The MCU wiki ('Ousted') says Ward and Joy were voted out of the company and offered severance (Iron Fist S1, around episodes 7-8). After Harold's death Ward proposes that he and Danny run the company together, and he is co-CEO. Note: the record's key is T:st-ward-meachum, not T:ward-meachum.

After Civil War Wanda is a fugitive. In Infinity War she returns to the Compound with Steve's group and fights with the Avengers, and the wiki lists the Avengers as an affiliation. This matches the hero file A:wanda-maximoff, which already has Independent at Civil War and Avengers at Infinity War.

The record has her in Strucker's HYDRA lab in the Captain America: The Winter Soldier mid-credits scene. She volunteered for HYDRA's experiments, and HYDRA is listed as an affiliation, so the first on-screen title she is in HYDRA is The Winter Soldier.
The MCU wiki lists O.X.E. as former and New Avengers as Yelena's current group. In Spider-Man: Brand New Day she still refers to 'the New Avengers', so the trailing Thunderbolts stage is wrong.

The MCU wiki lists the Ravagers and Yondu's Ravager Clan as former and the Guardians as current. The Guardians page says the team gained 'Mantis, Nebula and Yondu Udonta when they banded together to defeat Ego'. In Vol. 2 Taserface's mutiny deposes Yondu as captain.

Marvel Database files the Spider-Verse films' Miles universe as Earth-1610 ('EarthNumber 1610', page suffix 1610B). The twin A:sv-aaron-davis-itsv and 16 other records use Earth-1610, so a null Earth wrongly puts him on Earth-199999.
